content:
incident-bot: [P1] Metering anomaly detected — sudden surge in 'overage_flag' events with no corresponding token volume increase. Alert: https://infra.alerts/redwood/alerts/7921 :rotating_light:

maria.g: seeing it in the dashboard too. overage_flag rate jumped ~300x at ~11:12 UTC, but total_tokens_ingested looks normal.

alex.c: tagging oncall-ml, can someone confirm ingestion pipeline (kafka -> collector) health? could be a late-window duplicate emit or counting double-report.

oncall-ml: I'm on it. first pass: checking kafka lag + collector restart logs. also will check the atomicity change we rolled out last night for `emit_window_v2`.

sam.p: quick query against billing_writes shows a bunch of near-duplicate writes where request_id is null. simplified snippet:

```sql
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as writes, MIN(ts) as first_ts
FROM billing_events_v2
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-15T10:00:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY writes DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

sam.p: results show customer_x had 480 writes in the spike window but token_count sum is ~48k (expected ~4.8M). writes are tiny -> suggests flagging logic triggered incorrectly, not token inflation.

jia: looking at metering-collector logs, I see `WARN duplicate-window-detected` around the same time for many shards. collector v2 emits `overage_flag` when window metadata is missing. suspect race between window sealing and write-back.

alex.c: did we change window sealing semantics in last deploy?

oncall-ml: yes — we merged PR #582 that changed the commit order to reduce latency. rolling back that commit might remove the race.

dinesh: I can roll back the collector quickly. plan: rollback metering-collector to previous stable revision, then restart aggregator. Will take ~3-5m. anyone object?

maria.g: do it. also please pause outbound overage notifications to customers until we confirm counts. billing-ops, please mute or pause alerts in the notifications service.

billing-ops: pausing auto overage notifications for affected accounts now. created incident billing ticket INT-9142 and support tickets for top 10 impacted customers. message templates queued to send after reconciliation.

support-bot: support ticket created: #45321 assigned to Tier2 Billing.

dinesh: rollback complete. `kubectl -n metering rollout undo deployment/metering-collector --to-revision=12` returned OK. restarting aggregator: `systemctl restart metering-aggregator`

jia: aggregator restarted. I'm seeing de-dup metrics drop back to baseline in Prometheus: `metering_duplicate_window_total` trending down.

sam.p: re-ran the earlier SQL; duplicate write counts for customer_x dropped from 480 to 2 in the same window. token sums unchanged. looks good.

oncall-ml: next steps: keep collector rollback for now, run a targeted reconciliation job for last 2 hours to flag false overages and generate reversal records.

maria.g: agree. schedule reconciliation + dry-run for accounting team to validate before replaying reversals. timeframe?

dinesh: reconciliation job queued: `scripts/reconcile_overages --start '2026-03-15T10:00:00Z' --end '2026-03-15T12:30:00Z' --dry-run` Estimated run 7m. will post results.

alex.c: posting postmortem checklist here: 1) root cause = race in window sealing after PR #582, 2) immediate rollback of collector, 3) pause overage notifications, 4) run reconciliation job, 5) customer communications drafted but held until recon confirmed. anybody add?

oliver: add monitoring follow-up: add a health metric for `window_seal_latency` and an alert when `duplicate_window_detected` > 5/min. also add end-to-end test for window sealing under load.

maria.g: billing-ops please confirm when notifications can be re-enabled and which customers to notify first. we should avoid mass emails until reconciliation done.

billing-ops: will hold notifications. will notify top 3 paying customers proactively via account execs and offer reconciliation notes. will wait for dry-run confirmation.

dinesh: reconcile dry-run finished: 42 suspected false overage events across 9 customers. wrote summary CSV to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1718429876/reconcile-dryrun.csv. no reversals applied in dry-run.

oncall-ml: recommend run real reconciliation and backfill reversal records at 12:30 UTC after business review. will coordinate with billing-ops.

maria.g: good containment. incident status -> monitoring until 13:00 UTC, then move to mitigation and follow-up doc. I'll kick off the incident bridge for postmortem at 16:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident note appended — state=mitigated, severity=P1 -> monitoring. Bridge: https://meet.bridge/incident-1718429876
